payload.posture: Read Isaiah 56:1–8 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states foreigners, covenant keeping, joyful worship, offerings, gathering, and the house’s public name are joined. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
